environment.description: Identical application deployment on ECS Fargate behind ALB, but the ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with action override set to BLOCK and TextTransformation of URL_DECODE followed by HTML_ENTITY_DECODE applied to query string parameters and URI path, (2) Priority 200: A custom rate-based rule at 1000 requests per 5 minutes per IP. Additionally, the RDS PostgreSQL instance has the 'pgaudit' extension enabled logging all DDL and DML, and the database role used by the application has been configured with 'SET statement_timeout = 3000' (3 second query timeout) at the role level. The RDS instance is in a private subnet accessible only from the ECS security group.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, role has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on public.*, role-level statement_timeout=3000ms, pgaudit enabled
config.network: ALB with WAFv2 WebACL -> target group, RDS in private subnet
